notes: The Albums tab is manual-only again: it lists the albums YOU created, and no longer invents cards for albums that exist only as album tags on your files
Fixed the Albums tab counting every tagged song in your library — the header total and the play-all queue now cover just the songs in your albums
Dragging an album card can no longer save a tag-only album as a new album behind your back
Fixed the RGB theme colouring everything red and green: the hue cycle now starts from the theme’s own pink and blue and sweeps from there
RGB can no longer freeze on one colour. A failed tab-icon redraw used to end the animation for the rest of the session, leaving the accents stuck mid-cycle
RGB+ keeps its accent colour steady through a theme switch (its first frame used to read the theme you were leaving)
